title: Tech Gifts for Her: Trending Gadgets She’ll Love
description: Trending tech gifts for her: hair stylers, LED masks, e-readers, instant cameras, smart rings and more, plus what to check on subscriptions and sizing.
intro: A shortlist of the gadgets most searched for as gifts for women right now. Every gadget here works for anyone: filter by age, type and price.

cardText: Hair stylers, LED masks, e-readers, cameras and smart rings: popular tech gifts for her.

sections.html:
• Smart rings need sizing: order the free sizing kit first, or gift it with a note.
  • Beauty tech from authorised sellers only: counterfeit hair stylers are a known scam.
  • E-readers make great gifts at any age, especially with BookTok recommendations loaded on.
